# Respawn

Keeps the respawn timer at its configured length. Monolith#4808 scales it by the game preset from base values that
were never set, so every round start and restart left it at zero. The CVar setters in
`Content.Server/_Corvax/Respawn/RespawnSystem.cs` record the base; `RespawnTimerTest` covers it.
